scope: The original fixed-relation hyperplane note for primitive integral normals and ordered positive pairwise-distinct integer velocities: deterministic all-shift upper bound and exact containing-torus maximum; uniform inverse-box-size probability error over all shifts; fixed-shift and independent Haar-shift limit laws; full-support endpoint frequency including relation dimension one; exact positive-N denominator and subthreshold numerator quasipolynomials, with numerator degree at most k-2; finite proper rational-subspace classification; and a sharp inverse-box-size example. The original primitivity, real admissibility and full-support hypotheses remain where stated. No counting, finite-fan, Ehrhart, or classification theorem is assumed.
